GOAL
Build GI KERNEL V2.4 — THE ENFORCEMENT LAYER. Make the Graph Intelligence kernel a GATE ON THE
ACTION PATH, not a library the agent may consult. ONE goal. Authority: reports/GI_KERNEL_V2.4_DPL1_SPEC.md.
The measured failure this fixes: session 01a0c0e5 (PLUTUS VISION) ran 3 days; the GI decision tools
were called 0 times; the graph gate fired 1x in 2,450 edits. NO REMOTE JUDGE ANYWHERE — the local
judge (jevk5-4b-v0.2-Q8_0 on http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/systemone, FREE) decides everything.

BASELINE (re-measure THIS turn — inherited numbers are STALE until re-run)

  - the v2.3 seal: 2e2a39031c6059ca (Checkpoints/gi-jev-decision-layer-v2.3-redteam-ready)
  - the gate-ledger rows: wc -l ~/.omp/run/gate-ledger.jsonl (was 6,825, 0 jev:null)

  - ttsr.enabled / bash.patterns / tools.approvalMode: omp config get
  - the judge health: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8090/health
FIRST REPLY contract: re-measure the BASELINE AND fire W1 the SAME turn. Anything less is OPEN.

BUILD PACKAGE (on disk — the pin is VOID without it)

PHASES (each with its exit gate)
  P0 ABSORB (re-measure) · P1 SPEC (the DPL1) · P2 PREFLIGHT (each wave provable before it fires)
  P3 EXECUTE (parallel waves, disjoint files, per-wave audit) · P4 RUNTIME (the live seat)
  P5 ADVERSARIAL (the red team) · P6 DOCUMENT (canon + ship) · P7 CHECKPOINT · P8 VERDICT

WAVES (each carries an EDGE, never a file; disjoint files; governed by the wave plan at packages/gi-kernel-v2.4/WAVE_PLAN.md)
  W1 — the local judge -> the prose adjudicator
    files: extensions.DISABLED-20260924/lexicon-gate/lib.ts (the URL + model rewire)
    deliverable: the ledger row carries "jev":0.<p> (not null) for a gray-band span
    gate: test_lexicon_judge_is_local — 0 rows with jev:null after a fire
  W2 — the retrieval mandate -> the read path
    files: src/omp/gate-hook.ts (a bash branch), ~/.omp/agent/config.yml (bash.patterns)
    deliverable: a grep/sed over an indexable corpus throws GI_RETRIEVAL_GATE with the remedy
    gate: test_retrieval_gate_fires — the token IN A TOOL RESULT; a jev query SERVES
  W3 — the graph-query -> the edit path
    files: src/omp/graph-gate.ts (extend the candidate classes beyond stripped-exports)
    deliverable: an un-queried structural edit -> GI_QUERY_REQUIRED; a queried edit serves
    gate: test_query_mandate_fires — the token; the graph_gate_state records the history
  W4 — the derail classes -> the gate
    files: src/omp/gate-hook.ts (a rolling command counter + a ban table + the directives)
    deliverable: the same cd x3 trips the loop gate; the CDP ban is a predicate
    gate: test_derail_loop_trips — the token; 3 DISTINCT commands serve
  W5 — the done-claim -> the Jev route=act gate
    files: scripts/goal-verify.ts + the gate
    deliverable: "done" without route=act -> GI_DONE_UNPROVEN; with it, serves
    gate: test_done_gate_fires
  W6 — the substrate -> each workspace
    files: scripts/gi-populate.ts + the per-workspace .omp/lsp.json
    deliverable: an empty workspace -> GI_NO_SUBSTRATE; populate auto-runs
    gate: test_substrate_blocks — consumption-audit <root> --gate reads 8/8 ON THAT ROOT

LAWS
  - QUERY THE GRAPH before every structural edit: call the ripwire tool (verb=callers or verb=impact)
    on the symbol you are about to modify. A blind edit is the failure this build kills.
  - THE LOCAL JUDGE, ALWAYS: no api.typesafe.ai anywhere. grep -rn 'api.typesafe.ai' src/ scripts/ = 0.
  - A GATE THAT CANNOT REFUSE IS DECORATIVE: every gate ships a POSITIVE (must refuse) + a NEGATIVE
    (must serve). A gate with no negative control is a HYPOTHESIS, not enforcement.
  - AUTOMATIC FAIL: any gate that only WARNS (no throw) fails the wave on sight. Any row with
    jev:null fails the wave on sight. Any remote-judge reference fails the wave on sight.
  - EVERY wave closes on scripts/v24-firewall.sh exit 0 — a wave whose firewall is red is NOT done.

PROOF CONTRACT (the ONLY approved test: /prove-it; the DPL1 spec + the blueprint + the wave plan are the authority)
  A unit-test count is NEVER evidence. The build is PROVEN only by the /prove-it ladder:
  red-team-slop-audit §0 -> black-hat-audit-wave (>=2 independent auditors) -> runtime-testing
  (the 5-domain ladder + the 13-scenario derailment suite) -> deep-container-testing (a FRESH
  container; per-scenario passToken-in-tool-result / failToken-absent / the artifact JSON) ->
  deep-host-testing + runtime-grade (the LIVE host; the observer IS the subject) ->
  zero-trust-audit (every claim re-run) -> the PROOF_LEDGER at forensic/PROOF_LEDGER_v24.md.
  Test identifiers (>=3, selectable): test_lexicon_judge_is_local, test_retrieval_gate_fires,
  test_query_mandate_fires, test_derail_loop_trips, test_done_gate_fires, test_substrate_blocks.
  Tokens (tool-result-bound, NEVER agent-typeable): "jev":0.<p> in the lexicon-ledger · RC=0 ·
  "overallVerdict":"PASS" in ct-results.json · GI_RETRIEVAL_GATE / GI_QUERY_REQUIRED /
  GI_DONE_UNPROVEN / GI_NO_SUBSTRATE in a TOOL RESULT · the sha256sum deploy match.
  ADVERSARIAL-FIRST: the negative cases run BEFORE the happy path. The happy path is LAST.
  5+ angles: FIREWALL · TOOLS · AUDIT · ERRORS · BOUNDARY · STATE · CONFIG · INTEGRATION.

RUNTIME SEAT
  The live instance: the OMP host + the deployed GI extension + the local judge :8090.
  The seat: occupy the operator's chair — fire REAL gate scenarios in a scratch workspace, observe
  the fire-log + the gate-ledger rows, fix, redeploy, retest. The observer IS the subject.
  Push set: the extension dist + the config.yml + the .omp/lsp.json + the rules.

ADVERSARIAL LOOP
  adversarial-first (G6). Expand the corpus until a full pass is clean. A suite that finds nothing
  on first contact was designed wrong — widen the vectors.

DOC CONTRACT
  The 11 canon (context_management/) + the 5 ship docs (BUILD_REPORT · DEBUG_LOG · FAILURE_LOG ·
  TESTING_LOG · THEATRICALITY_LOG) + SPEC_VIOLATION_LOG. THE AUDIT GATE: qwen-code-audit (or the
  poolside-laguna-s lane) — a PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict line, never omitted. Density floors per class.

CHECKPOINT
  ROUND-ZERO before P3 (save the confirmed-working src + dist + docs). A sealed checkpoint at the
  end (Mode B or the lock) with the dist SHAs + the test counts + the 5 ship docs current.

HARD STOPS
  A gate that only WARNS -> STOP (it is decorative). A remote-judge reference -> STOP. A jev:null
  row -> STOP. A wave that merged files across desks -> STOP. A unit-test count offered as proof
  -> STOP, name the law, continue.

STOP
  The legal stop: all 6 waves green (each firewall exit 0) AND the /prove-it ladder PROVEN with the
  artifact AND the canon + ship docs current AND the checkpoint sealed. BLOCKED is a state, not a
  stop — name the resume condition. A stop without the terminal phase is OPEN.

ANTI-DERAIL
  - the scope-shrink: build ALL 6 waves; fewer is a FAILED build, not a smaller scope.
  - the advisory-kernel: a gate that warns instead of throws is the exact v2.3 failure.
  - the remote-judge: api.typesafe.ai is BANNED; the local :8090 is mandatory.
  - the file-organized wave: a wave naming a file and no edge is refused.
  - the green-battery-as-capability: tests pass but the gate never refused = decorative.

ANTI-STOP
  - the stationarity: a run that stops at "the code compiles" without the /prove-it proof is OPEN.
  - the memory-complete: a claim from memory (not a tool result THIS turn) is a hypothesis.
  - the theater-complete: "structural PASS" / "PASS by design" / "asserted the behavior" = FLAWED.
